shared_local_foundation_available.label: Repository provides a shared Python graph engine and mutation rules, JSON storage, CLI and editable local browser interface.

graph_tool_contract_defined.label: A versioned MCP contract defines explicit graph identity and access checks, revision-checked mutations, structured errors, explicit boolean values and condition indexing.

local_mcp_first_milestone.label: A local MCP client reads actionable matters and sets a verified condition through shared rules; stale or unauthorized writes change nothing and CLI and browser show the same graph without a Matters account.

graph_portability_available.label: Versioned export and import preserve existing graph data and citations, validate through the shared engine, rebuild optional caches and do not copy installation permissions.

local_mcp_available.label: Local MCP provides typed graph editing and source tools, configured graph access, credential-free project references and a demonstrated ChatGPT web connection via authenticated HTTPS or Secure MCP Tunnel while preserving account-free CLI and visual workflows.

shared_storage_interface_available.label: File-backed and database-backed transactions invoke the same graph rules, with passing compatibility and parity checks for existing local files.

hosted_accounts_and_access_available.label: Users can sign in and own separate personal and project graphs; server-side roles check every operation using authenticated identity.

hosted_graph_service_available.label: Hosted graphs have stable IDs, persistent transactional storage, revision-checked writes, change history and the same authenticated HTTPS MCP tools, with isolation and concurrent-edit tests passing.

hosted_visual_interface_available.label: Authenticated web users can select and edit their permitted graphs using reused visual controls; hosted routes expose no terminal or arbitrary filesystem selection.

cloud_hosting_and_operations_ready.label: Provider, region and recovery targets are recorded, and the deployment demonstrates HTTPS, protected secrets, monitoring, resource limits, encrypted backups and a successful restore.

matters_cloud_pilot_available.label: A pilot user creates personal and project graphs, uses browser and remote MCP editing, and moves a graph through verified export and import without cross-user access.

graph_collaboration_available.label: Whole graphs support owner, editor and viewer invitations and revocation; simultaneous edits produce reviewable conflicts and clients can refresh changes without exposing other graphs.

cloud_commercial_policy_decided.label: Measured pilot usage supports a recorded decision on hosting costs, free allowance, billing units, prices, model costs and data-preserving over-limit behavior.

cloud_subscriptions_and_limits_available.label: Subscriptions update entitlements through verified replay-safe billing events, and usage limits apply across every interface while cancellation and over-limit use retain data and export.

matters_cloud_available.label: The hosted service demonstrates accounts, durable personal and project graphs, browser and MCP controls, collaboration, a free allowance, paid upgrades and tested recovery.

private_company_requirements_agreed.label: A company pilot agrees identity, access, network connectivity, model data egress, residency, retention, support and recovery requirements without requiring a public Matters Cloud account.

private_company_isolation_available.label: The company deployment uses separate database, storage, network, keys, credentials and backups, with company identity configuration and passing isolation tests.

private_company_operations_ready.label: Provisioning, upgrades, rollback, restore, controlled support access and export/offboarding are demonstrated using shared software releases and agreed company requirements.

private_hosted_matters_available.label: A company pilot operates the shared engine and MCP tools in an isolated installation with agreed controls, verified recovery and an accepted managed-service handover.

matters_product_available.label: Local Matters, Matters Cloud and private hosted Matters operate with one shared engine and consistent MCP tools, preserve local workflows and support graph portability.
